name: Isooctyl thioglycolate
description: Isooctyl thioglycolate (CAS 25103-09-7 ), also known as isooctyl mercaptoacetate, is a sulfur-containing ester used as a reactive intermediate and functional additive across polymer, rubber, and lubricant applications. It acts as a chain transfer agent, plasticizer, and stabilizer component depending on the formulation system. In PVC and polymer processing, it functions as a co-stabilizer component and plasticizing modifier. This chemical improves flexibility and thermal processing performance in finished compounds. Rubber formulators use it to influence vulcanization chemistry and as a softening agent in specialty elastomer blends. In lubricant and metalworking fluid formulations, it contributes sulfur-active functionality relevant to extreme-pressure and boundary lubrication performance. It also serves as a monomer or chain transfer agent. This is particularly useful in free-radical polymerization, where controlled molecular weight distribution is a process requirement. Isooctyl thioglycolate is supplied as a liquid for industrial use. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with purity specifications typically confirmed by GC analysis.
